description: Who holds US Treasury securities, from the Treasury's TIC system: the major foreign holders by country at the last thirteen month ends, each with its change on a year, share of all foreign holdings and rank, the total and what foreign official institutions hold (bills against notes and bonds); or one country's holdings month by month. No key.

country.description: A country in the Treasury's table (China, Japan, United Kingdom...); default every one.

months.description: Month ends to show, latest last; default 13 for one country, 1 for the table (with the change on a year).

name: treasury_holders

outputSchema.description: the table: a row a country, largest first, with its holdings in billions of dollars at each month shown, its change on a year and its share; one country: a row a month.

title: Foreign holders of US Treasuries (TIC)
